# server.config

> Serves timeouts and base URLs, checking env overrides first.

Never hardcode a timeout or a base URL at a call site.

There is no automatic `{SERVICE}_TIMEOUT_MS` convention — the env var name is an explicit
argument, so adding a knob means naming it here.

## Interface

Entrypoint: `defaults.ts`

Anything not listed here is internal to this module:

- `getTimeout`
- `getUrl`
- `DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS`
- `DEFAULT_URLS`
